attributes.title: In place
attributes.lede: An employee profile, read and then written. Real fields at both ends.

lesson.concept: Content can change inside one continuous box
lesson.why: The read view and edit view have different markup but occupy one meaningful record. Crossing coordinates their skins with the box movement; the easing includes acceleration because editing is a considered transition.
lesson.experiment: Toggle editing while a field is moving, change a value, and exit. Look for preserved content and a box that lands at its actual form size.
lesson.pitfall: Replacing a live form with a screenshot loses caret, scroll and interactive continuity.
lesson.combine: Combine with a shared-layout selection marker while keeping form controls outside drag initiation.
